bronze.snippet: NVSR series publishes regular issues on provisional births, deaths, marriages, divorces, and leading causes of death. Each report includes detailed methodology, ICD-10 coding, age-adjusted death rates, and 95% confidence intervals. Volume/issue numbering provides stable citation handles.
bronze.notes: Stable volume/issue numbering; age-adjusted rates with confidence intervals ideal for uncertainty-language validation.

bronze.title: Monthly Climate Reports: Global Climate Report — Annual 2024
bronze.author: N/A
bronze.organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
bronze.snippet: NOAA Global Climate Report for Annual 2024: year was warmest since records began in 1850, at 1.29°C (2.32°F) above the 20th-century average of 13.9°C (57.0°F). Tables summarize global land, ocean, and combined anomalies; regional highlights; tropical cyclone counts.
bronze.notes: Vintage-stamped URL (202413 = annual 2024); NOAA NCEI authoritative climate record with explicit baseline period.

bronze.title: Fifth National Climate Assessment (NCA5)
bronze.author: N/A
bronze.organization: U.S. Global Change Research Program (USGCRP) — NOAA Institutional Repository
bronze.snippet: NCA5 (released Nov 14, 2023) is the congressionally mandated assessment of climate-change science, impacts, and mitigation/adaptation across U.S. regions and sectors. 32 chapters cover physical science, national topics, regional analyses, and response strategies; includes traceable accounts of confidence and likelihood.
bronze.notes: Mandated quadrennial U.S. climate assessment with traceable accounts (confidence/likelihood language); gold standard for uncertainty-aware claims.

bronze.author: N/A
bronze.snippet: Direct PDF of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations. ~481 pages with control families, baseline tables, and parameter assignment matrices; revision date and document ID embedded.
bronze.notes: Archivable canonical PDF of the same control catalog — duplicate coverage of the CSRC landing-page version for redundancy in corpus.

bronze.title: [PDF] The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
bronze.author: N/A
bronze.snippet: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 (NIST.CSWP.29) defines six Functions (GOVERN, IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND, RECOVER) with 22 Categories and 106 Subcategories, each cross-referenced to informative references.
bronze.notes: Replaces CSF 1.1; introduces Govern function; richly structured Function→Category→Subcategory hierarchy with cross-references to SP 800-53 controls.

bronze.title: SP 800-207, Zero Trust Architecture
bronze.author: S Rose
bronze.snippet: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture defines abstract ZTA with logical components (Policy Engine, Policy Administrator, Policy Enforcement Point) and four trust-algorithm inputs; deployment models include device-agent, sandboxing, and resource portal.
bronze.notes: Cited >3,100× — defines trust algorithms, deployment variants, and PE/PA/PEP component relationships; strong for entity-relationship claims.

bronze.title: Highly active hurricane season likely to continue in Atlantic
bronze.author: NOAA Communications
bronze.snippet: Updated NOAA outlook: 90% probability of above-normal 2024 Atlantic hurricane season. Demonstrates forecast-update language ('likely to continue', 'probability'). Useful for testing 'likely' vs 'certain'.
bronze.notes: Companion to CAND-JOU-004; useful for testing forecast-update vs initial-forecast drift.
